flags.reason: Paper reports separate mouse cohorts for different sub-experiments (8, 6, 17, and 3 mice) without stating an overall total exposed to ultrasound; unclear whether cohorts overlap.

The 1.16-13.55 W/cm2 range (robustness-score sweep) and the fixed 3.46 W/cm2 value (used for onset-time and histology experiments) are combined in one list; 3.46 W/cm2 has no separately stated pressure equivalent.

Domain assigned as free_field because the Methods state AI/pressure values were measured via hydrophone in a degassed water tank (and the in vitro AI is explicitly stated as measured in degassed water); the paper does not label every individual number with a domain.
Not stated as a percentage in the text; not computed from pulse duration and PRF per instructions.

readout_other: tail-flick motor response robustness scoring; fluorescence calcium imaging (OGB-1 AM) of cultured cortical neurons; H&E staining
direction_notes: Ultrasound evoked motor responses and triggered Ca2+ transients in cortical neurons (excitatory activation); ketamine dose-dependently blocked the US-evoked Ca2+ transients and suppressed motor responses in a deep anesthetic state.
safety_notes: Obvious morphologic changes or damage was not induced by US. Additionally, tissue bleeding or cytoplasmic swelling was not found in the stimulated cortical regions compared with control brain tissue.

timing.protocol_description: Two function generators were serially connected to generate bursts of pulsed waves, where the first function generator regulated the PRF, the SD and the inter-stimulus interval (ISI). Sonication was induced with 350-kHz FF, 1.5-kHz PRF, 0.23-ms TBD, and 66.67-ms SD; the robustness scores were evaluated for AIs varied 1.16-13.55 W/cm2 (0.06-0.69 MPa), and a fixed AI of 3.46 W/cm2 was used for the onset-time and histologic safety experiments.

Sonication was induced with the same parameters described earlier (350-kHz FF, 1.5-kHz PRF, 0.23-ms TBD, 66.67-ms SD) and the AI was set to 56 mW/cm2, measured in the degassed water; fluorescence was recorded for 3 min with US applied 1 min after recording started.
